title: Bangladesh HP crush Nepal in Top End T20 opener - Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)
description: Bangladesh HP crush Nepal in Top End T20 opener  Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)
publisher.title: Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)
full_article:
.detailImg{max-height: 450px; width: auto;} .dtl_img_section img{ max-width: 100% !important; }

DHAKA, Aug 22, 2026 (BSS) - Bangladesh High Performance (HP) team made a flying start to their Top End T20 campaign, whacking Nepal past by 9 wickets at Marrara Stadium in Darwin today.

Off-spinner Mohammad Rubel starred with the ball, taking 4-18 as Bangladesh restricted Nepal A to 99-9 in 20 overs.

Bangladesh HP gunned down the target in just 10.2 overs to seal a comprehensive victory with Jisan Alam hitting an unbeaten half-century.

Bangladesh captain Irfan Shukkur won the toss and opted to field, a decision that paid off immediately as Nepal lost five wickets for just 13 runs.

Kushal Bhurtel offered some resistance, scoring 46, while Sahab Alam made 11 and Bipin Khatri remained unbeaten on 11.

The rest of Nepal's batters failed to reach double figures.

Rubel was the pick of the Bangladesh bowlers, claiming four wickets in his four-over spell.

Samiun Basir, Ripon Mondol and Rohanat Doula took one wicket each.

Chasing 100, Bangladesh raced to 32 without loss after two overs. Habibur Rahman Sohan was dismissed in the third over, but his departure did little to slow the chase.

Jisan Alam then took charge, launching an aggressive assault alongside Ariful Islam.

He brought up his half-century from just 29 balls as Bangladesh reached the target in only 10.2 overs.

Jisan remained unbeaten on 52, while Ariful contributed an unbeaten 34 off 27 balls.

The victory marked Bangladesh HP's third appearance in the Top End T20 tournament in Australia. Bangladesh reached the final in one of their previous two campaigns but failed to win the title.

Bangladesh HP will face Hobart Hurricanes Academy in their next match at Marrara Stadium on Sunday.

ढाका, २२ अगस्त २०२६ : डार्विन केरऽ मरारा स्टेडियम म॑ आय नेपाल क॑ ९ विकेट स॑ आगू करी क॑ बांग्लादेश केरऽ हाई परफॉर्मेंस टीम न॑ अपनऽ टॉप एंड टी-२० अभियान केरऽ उड़ान भरलकै ।

ऑफ स्पिनर मोहम्मद रूबेल गेंद के साथ अभिनय करलकै, जेकरा म॑ बंगलादेश न॑ २० ओवर म॑ नेपाल ए क॑ ९९-९ प॑ सीमित करी देलकै ।

बंगलादेश एचपी न॑ महज १०.२ ओवर म॑ गोल करी क॑ जिसान आलम न॑ नाबाद आधा शतक के साथ व्यापक जीत प॑ मुहर लगाय देलकै ।

बांग्लादेश केरऽ कप्तान इरफान शुक्कुर न॑ टॉस जीती क॑ मैदान प॑ उतरै के विकल्प चुनलकै, जेकरऽ फैसला तुरंत फलित होय गेलै, कैन्हेंकि नेपाल न॑ महज १३ रन प॑ ५ विकेट गंवाय देलकै ।

कुशल भूर्टेल न॑ कुछ प्रतिरोध करतें हुअ॑ ४६ रन बनैलकै, जबकि साहब आलम न॑ ११ आरू बिपिन खत्री ११ रन प॑ नाबाद रहलै ।

नेपाल के बाकी बल्लेबाज दोगुना आंकड़ा तक पहुंचय मे असफल रहल।

रूबेल बांग्लादेश केरऽ गेंदबाजऽ के पिक छेलै, जेकरा म॑ हुनी अपनऽ चार ओवर के स्पेल म॑ चार विकेट प॑ दावा करलकै ।

समिउन बसीर, रिपोन मोंडोल आ रोहनत डौला एक-एक विकेट लेलक।

100 रन के पीछा करैत बांग्लादेश दू ओवर के बाद बिना हार के 32 रन तक पहुंच गेल। हबीबुर रहमान सोहन क॑ तेसरऽ ओवर म॑ आउट करी देलऽ गेलै, लेकिन ओकरऽ जाय स॑ पीछा धीमा करै म॑ कोय काम नै करलकै ।

एकरऽ बाद जीसान आलम न॑ अरिफुल इस्लाम के साथ-साथ आक्रामक हमला करी क॑ प्रभार संभाललकै ।

ओ मात्र २९ गेंद सँ अपन आधा शतक बनौलनि, जखन कि बंगलादेश मात्र १०.२ ओवर मे लक्ष्य पर पहुँचि गेल छल ।

जिसान ५२ रन पर नाबाद रहलै, जबकि अरिफुल न॑ २७ गेंद प॑ नाबाद ३४ रन के योगदान देलकै ।

ई जीत स॑ बांग्लादेश एचपी न॑ ऑस्ट्रेलिया म॑ आयोजित टॉप एंड टी-२० टूर्नामेंट म॑ तीसरा बार शामिल होय गेलऽ छै । बांग्लादेश अपनऽ पिछला दू अभियानऽ म॑ स॑ एगो अभियान म॑ फाइनल म॑ पहुँची गेलऽ छेलै लेकिन खिताब नै जीत॑ सकलऽ छेलै ।

रविदिन मरारा स्टेडियम मे बंगलादेश एचपी के अगिला मैच मे होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी के सामना होयत।

title: Government and 'Nation, Nationality, Religion, Culture and Citizen Protection Great Campaign, Nepal' Reach 14-Point Agreement - Ratopati
description: Government and 'Nation, Nationality, Religion, Culture and Citizen Protection Great Campaign, Nepal' Reach 14-Point Agreement  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. A 14-point agreement has been reached between the government led by Prime Minister Balendra Shah and 'Nation, Nationality, Religion, Culture and Citizen Protection Great Campaign, Nepal'.

With the agreement, the Great Campaign has decided to end all its धरना and protest programs from today itself.

The agreement paper was signed after intensive discussions between the representatives of the Great Campaign, who were staging a धरना at Pulchowk, Lalitpur, and the government-formed negotiation team. Prime Minister's Press Advisor Deepa Dahal made this agreement public through the social media Facebook.

On behalf of the government, Lilaadhar Subedi, coordinator of the negotiation team and joint secretary of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers' office, and on behalf of the Great Campaign, Vishnu Bohora Kshetri, coordinator of the negotiation committee, signed the agreement paper.

It has been stated that the citizens' demands will now be addressed through government processes after the uncomfortable situation created by the movement centered in the Kathmandu Valley was resolved through talks and agreement. Following the agreement, the धरना that was being held in the Pulchowk area has also been removed from today.

title: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified - News On AIR
description: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified  News On AIR
publisher.title: News On AIR
full_article:
India has rejected Nepal’s claim over Lipulekh Pass, termed it as a long-standing route for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra since 1954 and the Yatra through this route has been going on for decades. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal in a social media post said this in response to claims related to border issues made by Foreign Ministry of Nepal in the context of the annual Kailash Manasarovar Yatra.

He stressed that India’s position in this regard had been consistent and clear and this is not a new development. Mr Jaiswal pointed out that India has consistently maintained that such claims are neither justified nor based on historical facts and evidence. He stressed that such unilateral artificial enlargement of territorial claims is untenable. The spokesperson added that India remains open to a constructive interaction with Nepal on all issues in the bilateral relationship, including on resolving agreed outstanding boundary issues through dialogue and diplomacy.

title: Nepalese authorities propose renaming Annapurna I peak in honor of Nirmal Purja - Qazinform
description: Nepalese authorities propose renaming Annapurna I peak in honor of Nirmal Purja  Qazinform
publisher.title: Qazinform
full_article:
According to Everest Chronicle, the decision was taken at the municipality’s executive meeting on Tuesday, chairman Bharat Kumar Pun confirmed.

“His contribution to mountaineering, adventure tourism and the understanding of human capability is unmatched. He was not only a pioneer in mountaineering, but also in demonstrating human possibility,” Pun said.

Officials are considering a life‑size statue at Annapurna Base Camp, though the final location has yet to be determined.

The municipality has also proposed renaming Annapurna I (8,091 m), widely considered the world's deadliest peak, as “Nimsdai Annapurna." The proposal first will be submitted to the federal government after consultation with Purja’s family.

In addition, the Maurice Herzog trekking trail, named after the French climber who first summited Annapurna I in 1950, may be renamed the “Nimsdai Maurice Herzog Trail.”

Purja, widely known as Nimsdai, was regarded as one of the most accomplished high-altitude climbers of his generation. Born in Nepal, he served for 16 years in the military, including six years with the Gurkhas and a decade with the UK's elite Special Boat Service, before turning his focus to mountaineering.

एवरेस्ट क्रॉनिकल के अनुसार मंगलदिन नगरपालिका के कार्यकारिणी बैसार मे ई निर्णय लेल गेल अध्यक्ष भरत कुमार पुन पुष्टि केलनि अछि ।

पुन कहलनि जे, पर्वतारोहण, साहसिक पर्यटन आ मानव क्षमता के समझ मे हुनकर योगदान बेजोड़ अछि, ओ न सिर्फ पर्वतारोहण मे अग्रणी छलाह, बल्कि मानवीय संभावना के प्रदर्शन मे सेहो अग्रणी छलाह।

अधिकारी अन्नपूर्णा बेस कैंप मे जीवन आकार क मूर्ति बनेबा पर विचार क रहल छथि, हालांकि अंतिम स्थान एखन धरि तय नहि भ सकल अछि।

नगरपालिका अन्नपूर्णा प्रथम (८,०९१ मीटर) के नाम बदलै के प्रस्ताव भी रखन॑ छै, जेकरा व्यापक रूप स॑ दुनिया केरऽ सबसें घातक चोटी मानलऽ जाय छै, “निम्सदाई अन्नपूर्णा” के नाम स॑ बदललऽ जाय । प्रस्ताव पहिने पुरजा के परिवार सं परामर्श केलाक बाद संघीय सरकार के सौंपल जाएत.

एकरऽ अलावा 1950 में सबसें पहलऽ अन्नपूर्णा प्रथम के शिखर पर पहुँचै वाला फ्रांसीसी पर्वतारोही के नाम पर मौरिस हर्जोग ट्रेकिंग ट्रेल के नाम बदली क॑ “निम्सदाई मौरिस हर्जोग ट्रेल” रखलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।

निम्सदाई के नाम स॑ व्यापक रूप स॑ जानलऽ जाय वाला पुरजा क॑ अपनऽ पीढ़ी केरऽ सबसें कुशल उच्च ऊंचाई प॑ चढ़ै वाला म॑ स॑ एक मानलऽ जाय छेलै । नेपाल मे जन्मल ओ १६ वर्ष धरि सेना मे सेवा केलनि, जाहि मे छह साल गोरखा संग आ एक दशक यूके के कुलीन स्पेशल बोट सर्विस के संग रहल, आ फेर अपन ध्यान पर्वतारोहण दिस मोड़लनि ।

title: Protests erupt in Nepal over suspected rape, murder of three-year-old girl - Daily Excelsior
description: Protests erupt in Nepal over suspected rape, murder of three-year-old girl  Daily Excelsior
publisher.title: Daily Excelsior
full_article:
KATHMANDU, Aug 22: The suspected rape and murder of a three-year-old girl in Nepal has triggered protests with locals obstructing the Birgunj-Pathlaiya road section of Simara for the fourth consecutive day today.

The girl, a resident of Bhaktinagar in Jeetpur sub-metropolitan city of Bara district of Madhesh province, was found dead near her house on August 18, three days after she went missing.

Locals staged a sit-in on the Birgunj-Pathlaiya section of Simara by installing a tent demanding justice for the girl, the police said. The police suspect that the girl was murdered after being raped.

The police have arrested two suspects in the case so far.

A 16-year-old local youth, who had also been helping with the search for the missing girl, was arrested with the help of sniffer dogs deployed to search the area, Kathmandu Post newspaper reported.

The teenager confessed to luring the child with chocolate before assaulting and killing her, according to the police.

Police later arrested 24-year-old Progres Chaudhary, the owner and driver of a local public transport vehicle, the newspaper reported. The 16-year-old suspect worked as a co-driver for Chaudhary.

Both suspects remain in police custody after a court granted a four-day remand for further investigation, the report said.

Various political parties and civil society groups have demanded stern legal action after a thorough investigation into the incident.

Meanwhile, Home Minister Sudan Gurung has assured strong action against the culprits. Expressing deep sorrow over the incident, he underscored the government's commitment to achieving justice. (PTI)

विभिन्न राजनीतिक दल आ नागरिक समाज के समूह घटना के गहन जांच के बाद कड़ा कानूनी कार्रवाई के मांग केलक अछि।

ओतहि गृहमंत्री सूडान गुरुंग अपराधी के खिलाफ कड़ा कार्रवाई के आश्वासन देलखिन्ह. एहि घटना पर गहींर दुख व्यक्त करैत ओ सरकारक न्याय प्राप्त करबाक प्रतिबद्धता पर जोर देलनि। (पीटीआई) २.

title: Legitimacy dispute dents NC unity bid - The Rising Nepal
description: Legitimacy dispute dents NC unity bid  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, Aug. 23: The Nepali Congress is facing a serious internal test, with party President Gagan Kumar Thapa’s leadership pushing ahead with the party’s 15th General Convention while the faction led by former president Sher Bahadur Deuba continues to challenge the legitimacy of the process.

The dispute, which began with the Special General Convention, has now moved beyond a contest over leadership. It has become a wider debate over the future direction of Nepal’s oldest democratic party, with questions of party unity, internal democracy, the authority to convene the general convention and the role of the judiciary all converging.

The Election Commission and Supreme Court have recognised the leadership that emerged from the Special General Convention.

However, the Supreme Court has since agreed to review its earlier decision following petitions filed by Deuba and former acting president Purna Bahadur Khadka, keeping the leadership dispute alive.

Deuba, who returned to Nepal after five months’ stay abroad for treatment, has brought confidence to his faction, seeking legitimization of previous central committee.

However, the Nepali Congress Central Working Committee has fixed the 15th General Convention for October 2-5 and is moving ahead with preparations. They argue that the special general convention reflected the demand for change from a majority of party representatives and that the party cannot return to its previous leadership arrangement.

Nepali Congress spokesperson Devraj Chalise said the current rift was largely the result of some leaders refusing to accept the demand for change from party cadres and the public.

“The current rift is just the making of some leaders who cannot bear with the fact that the cadres and public want change within the largest democratic party of Nepal,” said Chalise.

He said the political environment following the Gen Z movement had forced the Nepali Congress to reconsider its organisation and relationship with voters.

“After the Gen Z movement, Nepali Congress saw that it needed to have a reform within itself to be closer to the public and understand public’s mandate,” he said.

Chalise maintained that more than 50 per cent of party representatives had supported the demand for the Special General Convention and that both the Election Commission and Supreme Court had already legitimised the process.

“Even after all this, instead of uniting the party, some people within the party are trying to cause inter-party rift,” he said.

He said the party should now focus on the convention already announced.

“Party convention has already been announced and it will go on according to the schedule. The only way forward is to understand that the convention will happen and the decision made from that convention will be the way forward for the party,” said Chalise.

The establishment faction has sought to portray the coming convention as an opportunity for organisational renewal rather than merely another leadership contest.

The Deuba faction, however, remains firmly opposed to the special general convention and argues that it was conducted outside the authority provided by the party statute.

Min Bahadur Bishwakarma, a leader of the Deuba faction, said the dispute had to be viewed against the political turmoil surrounding the Gen Z movement.

“The Gen Z movement saw much infrastructure destruction. The party offices of political parties were burned down. So many casualties took place. And our leader Sher Bahadur Deuba was attacked and injured,” said Bishwakarma.

He said the unrest had put the constitution and national sovereignty under serious pressure. “The constitution and the sovereignty of the country were put in danger and it still is in danger. So many institutions have been damaged,” he said.

Bishwakarma argued that, instead of bringing the party together

during such a difficult period, some leaders moved towards a special general convention.

“During these kinds of times, some leaders within the party, instead of uniting and moving forward, called for special convention,” he said.

He rejected the legality of the special general convention and maintained that the central working committee under Deuba should have remained responsible for organising the party’s regular convention.

“The special convention, how it was done and how it took place is not legal according to the party statute. It is totally illegal. The only way forward was via party convention called by then central committee members under Sher Bahadur Deuba.

But that was overridden illegally via special convention,” said Bishwakarma.

The Supreme Court’s decision to review its earlier ruling has provided the Deuba faction with renewed grounds to pursue its legal challenge. However, the decision to review the case does not itself overturn the existing recognition of the Thapa-led leadership.

Despite the differences, Bishwakarma said he did not want the dispute to result in a permanent split.

“As per unification or breaking the party, I am always for unification. This historic party has a part to play in Nepali politics. It has a role to play in saving the country's constitution and sovereignty,” he said.

He said his faction would accept the outcome of a convention it considers legally constituted.

“When the legal party convention will take place and new representatives will be elected, we will all agree to the result. But for now, we will fight for what is right,” said Bishwakarma.

The position reflects the central contradiction facing the Nepali Congress. Both factions speak of unity, but they disagree fundamentally over the organisational process through which that unity should be achieved.

The Deuba faction has also held a separate national gathering, where its leaders rejected the special general convention and called for a unified 15th General Convention. The Thapa faction, however, has rejected the authority of such a parallel gathering to determine official party policy.

Amid the confrontation, general secretary Pradip Paudel has emerged as a voice for reconciliation. In an appeal to party leaders and cadres, Paudel warned that the Nepali Congress could not afford to remain consumed by its internal dispute while the country was facing political uncertainty.

“The Nepali Congress is not just a political party, it is a democratic movement that carries the trust of the common Nepali people, the carrier of rights, and the dream of the country's prosperity,” Paudel wrote via social media.

He said the events surrounding the Gen Z movement and their aftermath had left the country at a difficult juncture and urged the party to look beyond its

internal troubles.

“If the Nepali Congress itself is not vigilant and strong in such critical times, the country is at risk of falling into a whirlpool of major political chaos,” he added.

Paudel appealed to both factions to resolve their differences through dialogue rather than prolonged legal and organisational confrontation.

“This is not the time to take our internal disagreements to the streets or wait at the courthouse. I think that the Nepali Congress dispute is not and should not be a matter for the courts to resolve. Political issues can only be resolved through political dialogue,” he added.

He urged dissatisfied leaders and workers to return to the party headquarters in Sanepa for talks.

“Let us sit in Sanepa and have a dialogue. Let us accept the leadership that will be handed over by the common workers by holding the upcoming 15th General Convention on time and embark on the path of further strengthening democracy together,” he added.

For the Thapa faction, the challenge is to ensure that the October convention is sufficiently broad and credible to bring the dissident camp back into the mainstream. Thapa has indicated that he is willing to address concerns over membership and the fairness of the convention process.

For the Deuba faction, the immediate priority remains securing recognition of what it considers the legitimate organisational structure before accepting the convention process.

एक स्टाफ रिपोर्टर, काठमांडू, 23 अगस्त : नेपाली कांग्रेस के गंभीर आतंरिक परीक्षा के सामना करय पड़ि रहल अछि, पार्टी के अध्यक्ष गगन कुमार थापा के नेतृत्व पार्टी के 15म आम अधिवेशन के आगू बढ़ा रहल अछि जखन कि पूर्व अध्यक्ष शेरबहादुर देउबा के नेतृत्व वाला गुट एहि प्रक्रिया के वैधता के चुनौती देबय के काज जारी अछि.

विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन स शुरू भेल विवाद आब नेतृत्व क मुकाबला स आगू बढ़ि गेल अछि। नेपाल केरऽ सबसें पुरानऽ लोकतांत्रिक दल केरऽ भविष्य केरऽ दिशा प॑ ई एगो व्यापक बहस बनी गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ पार्टी एकता, आतंरिक लोकतंत्र, सामान्य अधिवेशन केरऽ आह्वान करै के अधिकार आरू न्यायपालिका के भूमिका के सवाल सब एकजुट होय गेलऽ छै ।

चुनाव आयोग आ सर्वोच्च न्यायालय विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन स निकलल नेतृत्व कए मान्यता देलक अछि।

लेकिन एकरऽ बाद सुप्रीम कोर्ट देउबा आरू पूर्व कार्यवाहक अध्यक्ष पूर्णबहादुर खड्का केरऽ याचिका के बाद अपनऽ पूर्व फैसला के समीक्षा करै प॑ सहमत होय गेलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ नेतृत्व विवाद क॑ जिंदा रखलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

पांच मासक विदेश मे रहला के बाद इलाज के लेल नेपाल वापस आयल देउवा अपन गुट के विश्वास दिला देलखिन्ह, जे पिछला केन्द्रीय समिति के वैधता देबय के मांग केलखिन्ह.

मुदा नेपाली काँग्रेस केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति १५अम सामान्य अधिवेशन २-५ अक्टुबरके लेल तय कएने अछि आ तैयारीमे आगा बढि रहल अछि । हुनकऽ तर्क छै कि विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन म॑ पार्टी केरऽ बहुमत के प्रतिनिधि स॑ बदलाव के मांग के झलक मिललै आरू पार्टी अपनऽ पूर्व नेतृत्व व्यवस्था प॑ वापस नै आबी सकै छै ।

नेपाली कांग्रेस प्रवक्ता देवराज चालीसे वर्तमान दरार बहुत हद तक पार्टी कार्यकर्ता आ जनता स परिवर्तन के मांग के किछु नेता स्वीकार करय स मना करय के परिणाम रहल बतौलनि ।

चालीसे कहलनि जे, वर्तमान दरार मात्र किछु एहन नेता के बनाबय के अछि जे ई बात के सहन नहि क सकैत छथि जे कार्यकर्ता आ जनता नेपाल के सबस पैघ लोकतांत्रिक पार्टी के भीतर परिवर्तन चाहैत अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन के बाद राजनीतिक परिवेश नेपाली कांग्रेस के अपन संगठन आ मतदाता के संग संबंध पर पुनर्विचार करय लेल बाध्य केलक अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन के बाद नेपाली कांग्रेस देखलक जे जनता के नजदीक रहय आ जनता के जनादेश के बुझय लेल ओकरा अपना भीतर सुधार के जरूरत अछि।

चालीसे के कहना छै कि पार्टी के 50 प्रतिशत स॑ अधिक प्रतिनिधि न॑ विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के मांग के समर्थन करलकै आरू चुनाव आयोग आरू सुप्रीम कोर्ट दोनों ही ई प्रक्रिया क॑ वैध बना चुकलऽ छै ।

ओ कहलनि जे, एहि सब के बादो पार्टी के एकजुट करय के बजाय पार्टी के भीतर के किछ लोक अंतरदलीय दरार पैदा करय के कोशिश मे लागल छथिन्ह.

ओ कहला जे आब पार्टी कए पहिने स घोषित अधिवेशन पर ध्यान देबाक चाही।

चालीसे कहलनि जे, पार्टी अधिवेशन के घोषणा भ चुकल अछि आ कार्यक्रम के अनुसार चलत, आगू के एकमात्र रास्ता इ बुझब अछि जे अधिवेशन होयत आ ओहि अधिवेशन स जे निर्णय लेल जायत ओ पार्टी के लेल आगू के रास्ता होयत।

स्थापना गुट न॑ आबै वाला अधिवेशन क॑ खाली एगो आरू नेतृत्व मुकाबला के बजाय संगठनात्मक नवीकरण के अवसर के रूप म॑ पेश करै के कोशिश करलकै ।

देउबा गुट, लेकिन विशेष सामान्य सम्मेलन के दृढ़ विरोध करी रहलऽ छै आरू ओकरऽ तर्क छै कि ई पार्टी के विधान द्वारा उपलब्ध कराय देलऽ गेलऽ अधिकार स॑ बाहर करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

देउबा गुटके नेता मिन बहादुर विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन के घेरने राजनीतिक उथल-पुथल के विरुद्ध विवाद के देखय पड़ल अछि।

विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन मे बुनियादी ढांचा के बहुत तबाही देखल गेल।राजनीतिक दल के पार्टी कार्यालय जरि गेल।एतेक जानमाल के नुकसान भेल।आ हमर नेता शेरबहादुर देउबा पर हमला भ घायल भ गेल।

ओ कहलनि जे, अशांति के कारण संविधान आ राष्ट्रीय संप्रभुता पर गंभीर दबाव आबि गेल अछि। ओ कहलनि जे, संविधान आ देशक संप्रभुता खतरा मे पड़ल आ एखनो खतरा मे अछि, एतेक संस्था के नुकसान पहुंचल अछि।

विश्वकर्मा के तर्क छल जे, पार्टी के एक ठाम लाबय के बजाय

एहन कठिन अवधि मे किछु नेता विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन दिस बढ़लाह ।

ओ कहलनि जे, एहि तरहक समय मे पार्टी के भीतर किछु नेता एकजुट भ आगू बढ़बाक बदला विशेष अधिवेशन के आह्वान केलनि।

ओ विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के वैधता के खारिज करैत कहलनि जे, पार्टी के नियमित अधिवेशन के आयोजन के जिम्मेदारी देउबा के अधीन केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति के रहबाक चाही छल.

ओ कहलनि जे, विशेष अधिवेशन, कोना भेल आ कोना भेल से पार्टी के विधान के अनुसार कानूनी नहि अछि, ई एकदम गैरकानूनी अछि, आगू बढ़बाक एकमात्र रास्ता छल शेरबहादुर देउबा के तहत तत्कालीन केन्द्रीय समिति सदस्य द्वारा बजाओल गेल पार्टी अधिवेशन के माध्यम स।

मुदा ओहि बात कए विशेष अधिवेशन क माध्यम स गैरकानूनी तरीका स ओवरराइड क देल गेल।Ó विश्वकर्मा कहला।

सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ अपनऽ पहलऽ फैसला के समीक्षा करै के फैसला स॑ देउबा गुट क॑ अपनऽ कानूनी चुनौती के आगे बढ़ाबै के नयका आधार मिललऽ छै । मुदा, मामलाक समीक्षा करबाक निर्णय स्वयं थापा नेतृत्वक नेतृत्वक विद्यमान मान्यता केँ पलटि नहि दैत अछि ।

मतभेदक बादो विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, ओ नहि चाहैत छथि जे एहि विवादक परिणाम स्थायी रूप सँ विभाजन हो।

ओ कहलनि जे, एकीकरण या पार्टी तोड़बाक अनुसार हम सदिखन एकीकरण के पक्ष मे छी, नेपाली राजनीति मे एहि ऐतिहासिक पार्टी के भूमिका अछि, देश के संविधान आ संप्रभुता के बचाबय मे एकर भूमिका अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, हुनकर गुट कानूनी तौर पर गठित मानल गेल अधिवेशन के परिणाम स्वीकार करत।

विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, जखन कानूनी पार्टीक अधिवेशन होयत आ नव प्रतिनिधि चुनल जायत तखन हम सब परिणाम पर सहमत होयब, मुदा फिलहाल हम सब जे सही अछि ओकरा लेल लड़ब।

ई स्थिति नेपाली कांग्रेस के सामने केन्द्रीय विरोधाभास के दर्शाबैत अछि । दुनू गुट एकता के बात करै छै, लेकिन संगठनात्मक प्रक्रिया पर मौलिक रूप स॑ असहमत छै, जेकरा माध्यम स॑ वू एकता प्राप्त करलऽ जाय ।

देउबा गुट अलग राष्ट्रीय सभा सेहो केने अछि, जाहि मे ओकर नेता विशेष आम अधिवेशन के खारिज क एकीकृत 15म महाधिवेशन के आह्वान केलक अछि। थापा गुट तथापि पार्टीक आधिकारिक नीति निर्धारित करबाक लेल एहन समानांतर सभाक अधिकार केँ खारिज क’ देलक अछि ।

मुठभेड़ के बीच महासचिव प्रदीप पौडेल सुलह के आवाज के रूप में उभरल छैथ। पार्टी के नेता कार्यकर्ता सब के अपील में पौडेल नेपाली कांग्रेस अपन आतंरिक विवाद स भस्म भ गेल रहय के सामर्थ्य नै राखि सकैत अछि, जखन कि देश राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता के सामना करय पड़ि रहल अछि, चेतावनी देलनि।

‘नेपाली कांग्रेस खाली राजनीतिक दल नै छै, ई एगो लोकतान्त्रिक आन्दोलन छै जे आम नेपाली जनता के विश्वास, अधिकार के वाहक, आरू देश के समृद्धि के सपना के वाहक छै ।’’ पौडेल सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम स॑ लिखलकै ।

ओ कहलनि जे जेन जेड आंदोलन आ ओकर बाद के घटनाक्रम देश के कठिन मोड़ पर छोड़ि देलक अछि आ पार्टी सं आग्रह केलनि जे ओ अपन सं आगू देखय

आंतरिक परेशानी।

ओ आगू कहलनि जे, सनेपा मे बैसि कए संवाद करी, आगामी 15म महाधिवेशन कए समय पर आयोजित कए आम कार्यकर्ता द्वारा जे नेतृत्व सौंपल जाएत ओकरा स्वीकार करि लोकतंत्र कए आओर मजबूत करबाक बाट पर एक संग आबि जाउ।

देउबा गुट के लेलऽ तत्काल प्राथमिकता बनलऽ छै कि अधिवेशन प्रक्रिया क॑ स्वीकार करै स॑ पहल॑ वू जेकरा वैध संगठनात्मक संरचना मान॑ छै, ओकरा मान्यता सुरक्षित करलऽ जाय ।

full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 21: National Assembly (NA) members have demanded action against the guilty, expressing sorrow over murder of a three-year-old Garima Chaudhary of Jitpur Simara sub-metropolis-1 after rape.

Speaking in zero hour of the meeting of the upper house of the Federal Parliament today, they stressed that violence against children and women should be controlled, children's safety should be ensured and government and security bodies should be serious towards such incidents.

Puja Chaudhary asked the government to stop violence against children and women and ensure girl's safety, demanding action against those involved in rape and murder of Garima.

Saying the security bodies were not serious towards the incident of missing of the child, Renu Chand drew the attention of the government and security bodies and demanded stern action against the guilty.

Similarly, Manrupa Sharma demanded the government to repatriate the body of Narayan Sarki of Parbat, who died in Dubai in course of foreign employment, to Nepal immediately and provide compensation to family.

Likewise, Rukmini Koirala suggested the government to carryout activities in order to provide appropriate price to farmers for their agro produces, ensure security to women and employment to youths.

Drawing the attention of the government towards losses caused by flood and landslide in Rolpa and Bajura, Krishna Bahadur Rokaya asked the government to make arrangement of relief to victim families by evaluating damages.

Ghana Shyam Rijal drew the government's attention towards peaceful protest and agitation launched by Dipa Nepali with slogan ' Government, is the room empty' and suggested to resolve problems through talks.

Similarly, Padam Bahadur Pariyar demanded the government to fully implement the agreement signed with family of Ganesh Nepali, who died in course of treatment after self-immolation attempt at Department of Passport, and declare Ganesh as martyr.

Bishnu Kumari Sapkota asked the government to immediately provide relief to families displace by landslide at Thabang of Rolpa and stern action against guilty of rape and murder case of Garima.

Expressing dissatisfaction towards increasing number of staffs at personal secretariat of ministers, Bishnu Bahadur Bishwokarma demanded to cut the number. (RSS)

बिष्णु कुमारी सापकोटा सरकार स कहलथि जे रोल्पा क थाबंग मे भूस्खलन स विस्थापित परिवार कए तत्काल राहत आ गरिमा क बलात्कार आ हत्या क मामला मे दोषी क खिलाफ कड़ा कार्रवाई कैल जाए।

मंत्रीक व्यक्तिगत सचिवालय मे बढ़ैत कर्मचारीक प्रति असंतोष व्यक्त करैत बिष्णु बहादुर विश्वकर्मा संख्या मे कटौती करबाक मांग केलनि। (आर एस एस) २.

title: Opinion | Nepal wants no Caesar - The Kathmandu Post
description: Opinion | Nepal wants no Caesar  The Kathmandu Post

full_article:
In 1937, The Modern Review (India) published an article titled The Rashtrapati written under the pseudonym Chanakya. It was written against the backdrop of rising strongmen in European states—Hitler in Germany, Stalin in Russia, and Mussolini in Italy. Chanakya is critical of Jawaharlal Nehru, whose popularity was rising among the Indian populace and the cadres of the Indian National Congress. The article was an early warning against the hero-worship of politicians and about how such behaviour from the citizenry, seeking a saviour, could jeopardise democracy. Chanakya recognises this peril and writes, “Therein lies the danger for Jawaharlal and for India.”

A new democracy like Nepal could also succumb to such a threat when personality cults are welcomed with adulation while dissent against deified political leaders is met with severe derision and cyberbullying. In a democracy, when citizens seek salvation from only one individual, it could undermine the distribution of power among public authorities.

In the aftermath of the Gen Z uprising of September, the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) secured a near two-thirds majority in March’s snap polls, instating Balendra ‘Balen’ Shah. The protests voiced a rejection of the older political parties, given their repeated failures to deliver, poor governance, sycophancy, economic stagnation, and corruption. The election slogan, Ab ki bar Balen sarkar and the RSP campaign were somewhat fixated on Balen’s popularity and on placing him in the prime minister’s chair.

Despite receiving an overwhelming mandate, the incumbent’s modus operandi has been called into question in terms of parliamentary processes, issuing ordinances, dealing with a constitutional body and at the diplomatic level.

Recently, the prime minister’s advisors summoned the chief and officials from the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA) and rebuked them over delays in an investigation, showcasing an overreach while undermining the independence of constitutional bodies. The operating style is further plagued by provocative statements. For instance, during his speech at the RSP general convention, he mentioned, “If required, we will consult with the CIAA not just for five hours but for five years.” The ad hoc behaviours of walking out of the parliament mid-session and reprimanding the head of a constitutional body do not bode well for a young democracy.

In a democracy, leaders matter, but lasting institutions matter more. Benjamin Jones and Benjamin Olken, in their paper, ‘Do Leaders Matter? National Leadership and Growth since WWII’, investigate whether leaders have an impact on the growth of the country. The article concludes that institutions play a bigger role than an individual leader in a democracy. It is not that countries like Nepal do not require strong leadership. But more than good leaders, they need strong institutions and branches of government that can maintain checks and balances against any form of executive overreach.

However, the graver threat to democracy emerges from the citizenry’s inability to question their leader, yielding to personality cults. When citizens turn leaders into messiahs, supporters struggle to hold their leaders accountable. The idea of not questioning the incumbent was evident from the RSP’s election campaign–‘Chup Chap Ghanti Chaap’ (quietly stamp the bell)—or the prime minister’s social media post that said dukkha hunus (rest assured). It is a telling sign when leaders encourage the public not to think critically or speak freely in a democracy, but to mechanically believe that the government is doing good work for the people. Advocating such a practice will be the death of a thoughtful Nepal. Dissent and questioning leaders are fundamental tenets in a democracy.

The single greatest blessing that emerged from the Gen Z movement is not that RSP now commands a majority in the House of Representatives. Instead, it is that the movement inspired the country’s youth to embrace their civic duty and actively participate in the democratic process.

The democratic process does not cease after voting. It is a continuous practice of seeking transparency, holding leaders accountable and asking questions from the very first day after a new government assumes power. When someone questions or criticises the Shah administration, it doesn’t necessarily mean they are loyal to the three legacy parties or are against the country’s development.

The pseudonym Chanakya was used by none other than Jawaharlal Nehru, who had been the president of the Indian National Congress for two consecutive terms. Nehru’s self-deprecating article warns the citizens and writes, “What if the fancy turns? Men like Jawaharlal, with all their capacity for great and good work, are unsafe in democracy. He calls himself a democrat and a socialist, and no doubt he does so in all earnestness, but every psychologist knows that the mind is ultimately a slave to the heart and logic can always be made to fit in with the desires and irrepressible urges of a person. A little twist and Jawaharlal might turn a dictator, sweeping aside the paraphernalia of a slow-moving democracy.”

The fallacy of hero-worship is the belief that a single leader will provide Nepal with its elixir for development. Leaders require loyalty from their supporters. However, both leaders and supporters need to draw a line between loyalty and sycophancy. The onus is on the citizens and party loyalists not to surrender themselves to a messiah. Nehru ends the article with, “We want no Caesars.” It is a warning to a democracy not to fall under the spell of a popular leader. Democracy in Nepal will be measured by the creation of stronger institutions, not by relying on a Nepali Caesar to save the country.
translated:
1937 मे द मॉडर्न रिव्यू (इंडिया) मे चाणक्य छद्म नाम सँ लिखल गेल द राष्ट्रपति नामक लेख प्रकाशित भेल । ई यूरोपीय राज्यऽ म॑ उभरतऽ ताकतवरऽ के पृष्ठभूमि म॑ लिखलऽ गेलऽ छेलै-जर्मनी म॑ हिटलर, रूस म॑ स्टालिन आरू इटली म॑ मुसोलिनी । चाणक्य जवाहरलाल नेहरू के आलोचना करै छै, जेकरऽ लोकप्रियता भारतीय जनता आरू भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के कार्यकर्ता सिनी के बीच बढ़ी रहलऽ छेलै । लेख राजनेता केरऽ नायक-पूजा के खिलाफ आरू ई बात के पूर्व चेतावनी छेलै कि नागरिकऽ स॑ ऐसनऽ व्यवहार, जे उद्धारकर्ता के तलाश करी रहलऽ छै, लोकतंत्र क॑ कोना खतरा म॑ डाल॑ सकै छै । चाणक्य एहि खतरा केँ चिन्हैत छथि आ लिखैत छथि, “जवाहरलाल आ भारतक लेल सेहो खतरा अछि।”

नेपाल सन नव लोकतंत्र सेहो एहन खतरा के सामने झुकि सकैत अछि जखन व्यक्तित्व पंथ के प्रशंसा के संग स्वागत कएल जाएत अछि जखन कि देवता बनल राजनीतिक नेता के खिलाफ असहमति के घोर उपहास आ साइबर धमकावे के सामना करय पड़ैत अछि. लोकतंत्र म॑ जब॑ नागरिक केवल एक व्यक्ति स॑ मोक्ष चाहै छै त॑ ई सार्वजनिक प्राधिकारी के बीच सत्ता के वितरण क॑ कमजोर करी सकै छै ।

सितंबर केरऽ जेन जेड विद्रोह के बाद मार्च केरऽ स्नैप पोल म॑ राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्र पार्टी (आरएसपी) क॑ लगभग दू तिहाई बहुमत मिललै, जेकरा म॑ बलेन्द्र ‘बलेन’ शाह केरऽ नियुक्ति होय गेलै । विरोध प्रदर्शन म॑ पुरानऽ राजनीतिक दलऽ के अस्वीकृति के आवाज उठैलऽ गेलै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरऽ बार-बार डिलीवरी म॑ विफलता, खराब शासन, सिकोफैन्सी, आर्थिक ठहराव, आरू भ्रष्टाचार छै । चुनावी नारा, अब की बार बालेन सरकार आओर आरएसपी के अभियान किछ हद तक बालेन के लोकप्रियता आओर प्रधानमंत्री के कुर्सी पर बैसाबय पर टिकल छल.

भारी जनादेश मिलला के बावजूद संसदीय प्रक्रिया, अध्यादेश जारी करै, संवैधानिक निकाय स॑ निपटै आरू कूटनीतिक स्तर प॑ वर्तमान केरऽ मोडस ऑपरेंडी प॑ सवाल उठैलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

हाल ही म॑ प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ सलाहकार न॑ प्राधिकरण केरऽ दुरुपयोग केरऽ जांच आयोग (सीआईएए) केरऽ मुखिया आरू अधिकारियऽ क॑ बुलवाय क॑ जांच म॑ देरी के चलतें हुनका डांटलकै, जेकरा म॑ संवैधानिक निकायऽ के स्वतंत्रता क॑ कमजोर करतें हुअ॑ ओवररीच के प्रदर्शन करलऽ गेलै । संचालन शैली आओर भड़काऊ बयान स परेशान अछि। जेना कि आरएसपी केरऽ आम अधिवेशन म॑ अपनऽ भाषण के दौरान हुनी ई बात के जिक्र करलकै कि “जरूरत पड़ला प॑ हम्मं॑ सीआईएए स॑ खाली पाँच घंटा नै बल्कि पांच साल लेली परामर्श करबै ।” मध्य सत्र मे संसद स बाहर निकलि कोनो संवैधानिक निकाय क मुखिया कए डांटबाक तदर्थ व्यवहार युवा लोकतंत्र लेल नीक संकेत नहि अछि।

लोकतंत्र मे नेताक महत्व होइत छैक, मुदा स्थायी संस्था बेसी मायने रखैत अछि । बेंजामिन जोन्स आरू बेंजामिन ओल्केन, अपनऽ पेपर म॑, ‘की लीडर्स मैटर? द्वितीय विश्वयुद्ध के बाद स॑ राष्ट्रीय नेतृत्व आरू विकास’, ई जांच करै छै कि देश केरऽ विकास प॑ नेता सिनी के प्रभाव पड़ै छै कि नै । लेख केरऽ निष्कर्ष छै कि लोकतंत्र म॑ संस्था केरऽ भूमिका व्यक्तिगत नेता स॑ भी बड़ऽ होय छै । एहन नहि जे नेपाल सन देश मे मजबूत नेतृत्वक आवश्यकता नहि अछि । लेकिन अच्छा नेता स॑ भी जादा हुनका सब क॑ मजबूत संस्था आरू सरकार केरऽ शाखा के जरूरत छै जे कोनो भी तरह के कार्यकारी ओवररीच के खिलाफ नियंत्रण आरू संतुलन बनाबै सक॑ ।

लेकिन लोकतंत्र के लेलऽ आरू गंभीर खतरा नागरिकऽ के अपनऽ नेता प॑ सवाल उठाबै म॑ असमर्थता स॑ पैदा होय छै, व्यक्तित्व पंथ के सामने झुकना । जखन नागरिक नेता कए मसीहा मे बदलि दैत छथि त समर्थक अपन नेता कए जवाबदेह बनेबा लेल संघर्ष करैत छथि । वर्तमान पद पर सवाल नै उठै के विचार आरएसपी के चुनाव प्रचार–‘चुप चप घंटी चाप’ (चुपचाप घंटी पर मुहर लगाबै)—या प्रधानमंत्री के सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट स॑ स्पष्ट छेलै जेकरा म॑ दुखा हुनुस (निश्चित रहऽ) कहलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । ई एकटा बताबै वाला संकेत छै जब॑ नेता सिनी जनता क॑ प्रोत्साहित करै छै कि वू लोकतंत्र म॑ आलोचनात्मक रूप स॑ नै सोचै या स्वतंत्र रूप स॑ बोलै, बल्कि यंत्रवत रूप स॑ ई मान॑ कि सरकार जनता लेली अच्छा काम करी रहलऽ छै । एहन प्रथाक वकालत करब एकटा विचारशील नेपालक मृत्यु होयत। लोकतंत्र मे असहमति आ नेता पर सवाल ठाढ़ करब मौलिक सिद्धांत अछि ।

जेन जेड आंदोलन स॑ जे एकमात्र सबसें बड़ऽ आशीर्वाद सामने ऐलै, वू ई नै छै कि अब॑ आरएसपी केरऽ बहुमत के कमान प्रतिनिधि सभा म॑ छै । बल्कि ई छै कि ई आन्दोलन देश केरऽ युवा सिनी क॑ अपनऽ नागरिक कर्तव्य क॑ अपनाबै आरू लोकतांत्रिक प्रक्रिया म॑ सक्रिय रूप स॑ भाग लेबै लेली प्रेरित करलकै ।

मतदान के बाद लोकतांत्रिक प्रक्रिया बंद नहिं होइत अछि. पारदर्शिता के तलाश, नेता सब के जवाबदेह बनाबय के आ नव सरकार के सत्ता ग्रहण के पहिल दिन सं सवाल पूछय के ई निरंतर प्रथा अछि. जखन कियो शाह प्रशासन पर सवाल उठबैत अछि या आलोचना करैत अछि त’ एकर मतलब ई जरूरी नहि जे ओ तीनू विरासत दल के प्रति वफादार अछि या देश के विकास के खिलाफ अछि.

चाणक्य छद्म नामक प्रयोग जवाहरलाल नेहरू के अलावा दोसर कियो नहि केलक जे लगातार दू बेर भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के अध्यक्ष रहल छल । नेहरू केरऽ आत्म-निंदा करै वाला लेख नागरिकऽ क॑ चेतावनी दै छै आरू लिखै छै कि अगर फैंसी घूमी जाय त॑ की होतै ।जवाहरलाल जैसनऽ आदमी, जेकरा म॑ अपनऽ महान आरू अच्छा काम करै के पूरा क्षमता छै, लोकतंत्र म॑ असुरक्षित छै । ओ अपना केँ लोकतांत्रिक आ समाजवादी कहैत छथि, आ निस्संदेह ओ पूरा गंभीरता सँ करैत छथि, मुदा हर मनोवैज्ञानिक केँ ई बुझल छनि जे अंततः मन हृदयक गुलाम होइत छैक आ तर्क केँ सदिखन कोनो व्यक्तिक इच्छा आ अदम्य आग्रहक अनुकूल बनाओल जा सकैत अछि। कनि मोड़ आ जवाहरलाल कोनो तानाशाह केँ घुमा सकैत छथि, धीमा गति सँ चलय बला लोकतंत्रक सामान केँ एक कात झाड़ि क’।”

वीर-पूजाक भ्रम ई विश्वास अछि जे एकटा नेता नेपाल केँ विकासक लेल ओकर अमृत उपलब्ध कराओत । नेता के अपन समर्थक स निष्ठा चाही। मुदा, नेता आ समर्थक दुनू के निष्ठा आ सिकोफैन्सी के बीच रेखा खींचय के जरूरत अछि. भार नागरिक आ पार्टी के वफादार पर अछि जे कोनो मसीहा के सामने अपना के नहि सौंपथि। नेहरू लेख समाप्त करैत छथि, “हमरा सभकेँ कोनो सीजर नहि चाही।” लोकतंत्र के लेल ई चेतावनी अछि जे कोनो लोकप्रिय नेता के जादू मे नहि पड़य. नेपाल मे लोकतंत्र के माप देश के बचाबय लेल नेपाली सीजर के भरोसे नहि, मजबूत संस्था के निर्माण स होयत।

title: Opinion | Nepal-China Ties at 71: Time to move beyond symbolism to substance - The Kathmandu Post
description: Opinion | Nepal-China Ties at 71: Time to move beyond symbolism to substance  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
As Nepal and China mark the 71st anniversary of their diplomatic relations, both nations have the opportunity to move beyond ceremonial commemorations and confront the hard realities that have left Kathmandu struggling to transform its geographical proximity to Beijing into tangible economic prosperity. This relationship, which reflects a civilisational grandeur, is increasingly tested by the complex nature of modern geopolitics, implementation failures and institutional frailties. This milestone therefore invites us not just to celebrate but, more importantly, to reflect, to assess, and to envision the future of our bilateral ties.

Civilisational dialogues

The Nepal-China relationship predates the very concept of nation-states. In the 5th century, the Nepali monk Buddhabhadra crossed the Himalayas to translate Buddhist scriptures in China. In the 7th century, Princess Bhrikuti carried Nepali civilisation to Tibet, where her influence on Buddhism remains legendary. Later, in the 13th century, the master architect Araniko made a lasting impression on Chinese art and architecture. His designs endure today as symbols of our shared creative heritage.

Far more than diplomatic missions, these were acts of civilisational dialogue, exchanges of knowledge, faith and artistic interactions that bound our peoples across the trans-Himalayan expanse long before the Westphalian system existed. Connected by the enduring legacies of two great philosophers, Gautama Buddha and Confucius, Nepal and China have maintained deep mutual respect for centuries. This is the legacy we have inherited.

The strategic shift

In 2019, Nepal-China relations took a decisive turn when the two countries agreed to elevate their ties to a forward-looking ‘strategic partnership’ under the Belt and Road Initiative, with the shared ambition of transforming Nepal from a landlocked country into a land-linked one. Since then, economic engagements have grown significantly. Yet, economic cooperation remains unbalanced, as does our trade deficit. This asymmetry in economic relations is not merely a statistic but a structural vulnerability. It is time to transform this asymmetry into a more balanced proportion.

Modern bilateral security is deeply intertwined with development and connectivity. True security is not merely defensive posturing at the border; it is the security of shared prosperity. Nepal-China relations have already evolved beyond the narrow confines of border stability and traditional security into a comprehensive partnership that emphasises connectivity, infrastructure and trade. The best way to build strong borders is based on mutual well-being, development and trust.

The geopolitical tightrope

Nepal’s position between China and India, two of the world’s fastest-growing economies with different political and economic systems, has long required a mature diplomatic balancing act. This approach demonstrates a remarkable capability for strategic restraint and autonomy. Yet such efforts also face immense headwinds.

In an increasingly polarised world, remaining non-aligned and neutral is difficult. China, India and a renewed US focus on this region. This evolving strategic triad constantly tests our political stability and institutional capacity. Geopolitical rivalry is complicating our connectivity projects, disrupting trade routes and casting a shadow over investment flows. As a result, international economic cooperation is faltering, national development strategies are getting undermined, and political instability is looming.

Our internal problems are far more significant than our external ones. After navigating through numerous challenges, Nepal’s political landscape has achieved a measure of stability, setting the stage for an era of economic transformation. Nepal was expected to make a quantum leap. Political stability is widely seen as the bedrock for prosperity, but it has also failed to unlock and expand economic opportunities. Instead, corruption, crony capitalism and rent-seeking have often prevailed, weakening the very political stability we achieved. This cycle has created deeper distrust, especially among the youth. When genuine economic avenues are lacking, even a strong political foundation begins to crumble. This raises an unavoidable question: why has Nepal not been able to harness the dynamism of China and India?

China certainly has implementation challenges. But a more critical question is whether Nepal itself has been able to effectively implement the agreements it has signed with China over the past decade. Have we remained stuck in political arrangements and institutional shortcomings that delay or hinder execution? Do we view cooperation with China through a parallel structural lens grounded in long-term strategic thinking, or see Beijing as a saviour only in moments of emergency? Are our perceptions shaped more by emotion than by rational assessment?

Beyond bilateral

The regional picture is equally frustrating. The huge disparity in population, geography and economic size among India, China and Nepal has long made genuine trilateral cooperation elusive. As the smallest partner, Nepal constantly navigates vast disparities in power and capacity. This structural imbalance often limits the scope for balanced three-way initiatives and puts pressure on Nepal’s ability to pursue independent economic and strategic choices.

Shifts in the global order might bring China and India closer. But the reality on the ground remains more complex. Persistent geopolitical tensions and big strategic differences continue to create a difficult, sometimes adversarial environment for their shared neighbourhood. Frameworks like the Bangladesh-China-India-Myanmar (BCIM) corridor and various trilateral dialogues remain largely aspirational. They generate headlines but rarely produce tangible outcomes. While economic logic is recognised, it simply fails to translate into sustained cooperation.

What comes next?

Looking ahead, the trajectory of Nepal-China relations will be shaped by the broader strategic competition between China and the United States, as well as by India’s enduring influence in the region. Nepal’s foreign policy has always been guided by national interest, not ideology or any particular value system. Our strategic calculus is based on avoiding any alignment, including multi-alignment. Instead, we need to practice a multi-engagement approach to maximise benefits, while maintaining our non-aligned credentials.

After years of constructive dialogue and careful consideration, we have a clear national consensus: to actively promote and deepen our economic cooperation within the framework of building the high-quality Belt and Road. In this context, economic and infrastructure diplomacy will continue to be central to our bilateral ties. However, we need new horizons too. Technological advancement and artificial intelligence are emerging areas where Nepal can access affordable new technologies and new products from China to enhance its development capacity and help address the difficulties holding back our progress.

We have history. We have geography. What we lack is the institutional discipline and strategic clarity to turn proximity into prosperity. Unless we address our domestic shortcomings first, neither our deep historical ties nor modern partnership will secure the future that we deserve. The Himalayas have connected us for centuries. It is time to build bridges worthy of the landscape itself.

title: Budget-friendly places for Nepali students in Nagoya - The Kathmandu Post
description: Budget-friendly places for Nepali students in Nagoya  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Fukiage

Fukiage sits in Chikusa Ward. It is a residential pocket—mostly apartment blocks and small local shops—that trades the buzz of downtown for quieter streets, while still keeping the city centre close enough for a daily commute.

Pros

The subway ride into Sakae takes about 10 minutes, and cycling takes around 15 minutes. Rents here are noticeably cheaper than in areas closer to Sakae, making it one of the better-value options for students who still want quick access to the city.

Cons

There is not much beyond convenience stores and a few local diners. Students wanting nightlife or a café scene will need to travel into Sakae or Imaike, adding transport costs on top of the savings on rent.

Imaike

Imaike sits at the junction of the Higashiyama and Sakura-dori subway lines. The streets around the station are packed with ramen shops and small local eateries. It functions as a mini downtown of its own, long favored by young Japanese residents.
translated:
फुकिआगे

फुकिआगे चिकुसा वार्ड मे बैसल छथि। ई एकटा आवासीय जेब थिक - बेसीतर अपार्टमेंट ब्लॉक आ छोट-छोट स्थानीय दोकान - जे डाउनटाउनक धूमधामकें शांत सड़कक संग व्यापार करैत अछि, जखन कि शहरक केंद्रकें एखनो रोज आवागमनक हेतु पर्याप्त नजदीक रखैत अछि.

पेशेवर

सकाई में सबवे के सवारी में करीब 10 मिनट लगैत अछि, आ साइकिल चलाबय में करीब 15 मिनट लगैत अछि. एहि ठामक किराया साकाए सं नजदीकक इलाका सं उल्लेखनीय रूप सं सस्ता अछि, जाहि सं ई ओहि छात्रक लेल नीक मूल्यक विकल्प में सं एक अछि जे एखनो शहर में जल्दी पहुंच चाहैत छथि.

विपक्ष

सुविधा स्टोर आ किछु स्थानीय भोजन करयवला सं आगू बेसी किछु नहिं. नाइटलाइफ़ या कैफे दृश्य चाहय वाला छात्र के सकाई या इमाइके में यात्रा करय पड़त, जाहि सं किराया पर बचत के संग परिवहन लागत सेहो जोड़ल जायत.

इमैक

इमैके हिगाशियामा आ सकुरा-डोरी सबवे लाइनक जंक्शन पर बैसल अछि. स्टेशन के आसपास के सड़क पर रेमन के दोकान आ छोट-छोट स्थानीय भोजनालय सं भरल अछि. ई अपनऽ मिनी डाउनटाउन के रूप म॑ काम करै छै, जेकरा बहुत दिन स॑ जापानी युवा निवासी सिनी के पसंद छै ।
